description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Navbar' that renders the top navigation bar of a web application. It includes a mobile menu toggle button, branding with logo, and navigation links for Home, Posts, Editor, and a 'New Post' button.

methods.name: Navbar
methods.description: React functional component that renders the navigation bar with optional sidebar toggle handler.

methods.name: handleToggle
methods.description: Handles the click event for the menu toggle button, invoking onToggleSidebar if provided.
